* **Image input**: The free quota applies per task; additional images are billed per image.
* **Video input**: Applies to reference tasks only. Billed by input duration at the output resolution of the selected model.
* **Audio input**: Free for all extended models.
* **MiniMax-H3-RH**: Request with `model=MiniMax-H3` and `resolution=480P`; there is no separate model name.
